messages:
ryan_support: Escalating request from Harbor Clinics onboarding to CS. Account HC-2026, ARR ~$420k. Theyre blocked at private connector provisioning + payload 422s. Renewal touchpoint in 9 days, customer asking for go-live date. Need CS to lead a privacy-safe bridge and comms plan.

ryan_support: Quick logs: connector setup failing with 502 when our on-prem proxy attempts TLS handshake; also repeating 422s for `patient.contact.email` validation when payloads are proxied. Saw a burst of retries at 03:12Z.

sec-bot: [security] Alert: attempted cert mismatch detected during proxied TLS handshake for HC-2026. Recommended to pause automated retries until certificate rotated.

isabel_cs: Taking lead. Primary ask: 1) stop aggressive retries to avoid exposing PII, 2) run a controlled cert rotate with customer, 3) schedule a 30m privacy-bridge with Eng + Security in next 90m. I'll own comms.

dave_se: On it. Hypothesis: their on-prem proxy presents an intermediate cert that our ingress rejects intermittently. Short-term mitigations: pause retries, enable lenient-cert-mode for a canary workspace, and perform a scoped cert rotate with the customer. If CS approves, I can enable lenient mode for 2h. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/onprem-tls-troubleshoot

hema_csm: Comms plan draft: 1) immediate short ping acknowledging and proposing a 30m bridge within the hour, 2) during the call we'll describe mitigations (pause retries, canary cert rotate, apply temporary ingest throttle), 3) follow-up summary that omits PII and provides next-steps and owner timeline. If unresolved after 24h, escalate to Renewals & Legal for a retention plan.

ryan_support: Executed: paused automated retries for org HC-2026: `set_org_retries HC-2026 --mode=manual --duration=24h`. Attached trimmed logs to INC-2026-401. Also noted their integration uses connector v1.2.3 which has known TLS fallback behavior.

sec-bot: [security] Recommended step: perform certificate thumbprint verification with customer before enabling lenient mode. Do not disable certificate validation globally.

dave_se: I will request a thumbprint from the customer on the bridge and only enable `lenient-cert-mode` for `hc-2026-canary` workspace for 2h if verified. Also prepared commands: `set_workspace_cert_mode hc-2026-canary --mode=lenient --ttl=2h` and `rotate_connector_cert hc-2026 --scope=canary`.

hema_csm: Proposed bridge 11:15 PT (in 40m). Invites sent to Harbor Clinics engineering, our Eng (dave), Security (sec-bot), and Support (ryan). Draft short ping to customer:
"Hi Aisha  thanks for the patience. Weve paused automated retries to protect your data and propose a 30m secure troubleshooting call at 11:15 PT to walk a controlled cert verification and short canary rotation. We will not expose any PII during the session.  Hema, CSM"

dave_se: Confirmed: will join and run canary cert rotate if customer provides thumbprint on the call. Also recommend temporary ingest throttle: `set_org_ingest_mode HC-2026 --mode=throttle --duration=48h` to avoid retry storms. Need CS approval.

isabel_cs: Approved throttle for 48h. Executing: `set_org_ingest_mode HC-2026 --mode=throttle --duration=48h` now.

ryan_support: Notified sales and Renewals about the P1 and renewal window. Also attached the SDK version matrix; flagged that customers on connector v1.2.3 should upgrade to v1.2.5 to avoid TLS fallback.

hema_csm: Post-call notes: customer provided cert thumbprint, canary workspace rotated successfully, ingests on canary accepted, and we re-enabled controlled retries for test workspace. Applied throttle org-wide. Customer retried a small batch and succeeded. Agreed to schedule full connector upgrade plan with their ops team next week. Next steps: 1) monitor for 72h, 2) share sanitized post-call summary to customer and internal INC-2026-401, 3) if instability continues escalate to Legal & Renewals to prepare retention outreach.

dave_se: Monitoring KV/ingest and TLS negotiation logs for HC-2026. Will recommend full rotation after 24h if canary remains stable.

isabel_cs: Update: initial metrics look good (failure rate ~45% -> 3% on canary). Keeping P1 open and will close thread when case shows 72h stable. If anything changes, will escalate per plan. :white_check_mark:
